reviews.title: Cheap, reliable, quality, and performance
reviews.comment: I've had this monitor for almost a year now and honestly I love this monitor. The ultra wide is great but when u dont need it, the PIP works so well and the graphics are really good. I dont experience bloom, frame drops, or stutter. For the money, it is totally worth it. Its super reliable too. I moved 3 times with it and it still works like day one
reviews.author: Marco Campos

reviews.title: Game-Changer for Productivity
reviews.comment: I’ve been using the Innocn 45” monitor for my daily work setup, and it’s been fantastic. The ultra-wide screen gives me more than enough space to run multiple windows side-by-side without feeling cramped, which has noticeably improved my productivity. The display quality is sharp, colors look great, and everything feels smooth and responsive. It’s especially useful for multitasking—whether I’m working across spreadsheets, emails, or creative projects, I rarely feel the need for a second monitor anymore. Setup was straightforward, and the build quality feels solid and premium. Overall, this monitor has been a huge upgrade to my workspace and I’d definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a large, high-quality display for work.
reviews.author: mmollat

reviews.title: Decent monitor
reviews.comment: Decent monitor for the money. It has speakers built in which is good if you want that but it does make the monitor more narrow height wise. Using on a racing simulator now. One thing I noticed is that it has the backlight glare where the backlights are which is something you usually you only see on older monitors. All in all worth the money but not great.
reviews.author: Bhavens

reviews.title: Garbage mounting system, Speakers don't last
reviews.comment: Monitor itself is okay, but the stand it comes with is terrible. The stand takes up a lot of space and does not have good adjustments. Trying to get a different mount is even worse as nothing fits into the awkward slot they made for the original stand. It's supposed to be able to use a 100x100 VESA mount, but every single one is just a bit too large to fit inside the deep circular slot, you could maybe get away with getting some extra-long bolts from the hardware store to make one work, but we shouldn't have to do that. A new issue I had is that at some random point I unplugged my headphones and all of a sudden, the built-in speakers took a dump. Now it sounds like they're blown out and I have no idea why this happened, I've never had the speakers above 50% either, can't even reinstall the sound drivers to try to fix the problem as that changes nothing.
reviews.author: Max

reviews.title: Best Monitor ever. Get this now.
reviews.comment: I absolutely LOVE this monitor. Super easy to set up, high quality video, and colors are amazing. The functionality of a 45" curved screen is unbelievable. You can use it for any CAD programming, 3D printing, gaming or just surfing the web. the ability to have it in both 4k and 5k is incredible. Completely worth the money. Will be getting another one to stack on top of the existing monitor.
reviews.author: James D
